# Code Review Report — PR #259 (Claude)

**Branch:** `docs/issue-257-opencode-runtime-auditor-mcp-deps`
**Reviewer:** Claude (Reviewer sub-agent)
**Date:** 2026-04-30
**Report path:** `.github/notes/reviews/2026-04-30-pr259-claude-raw.md`

---

## Review Summary

Single-line documentation update to `docs/features/opencode-runtime.md` that correctly extends the developer-local MCP dependency notice to cover the auditor family alongside the researcher family. The core intent is accurate: the auditor family does carry Tavily and Context7 dependencies. Two issues found: the enumeration omits `auditor.md` itself (verified against live agent frontmatter — it has both MCP tools enabled), and the companion file `AGENTS.md` was not updated and still describes only the researcher family as carrying these dependencies.

**Files Reviewed:** 1 (changed) + 2 (targeted verification: `auditor.md`, `AGENTS.md`)
**Findings:** 0 Critical, 2 Warning, 0 Suggestion

---

## Findings

### Warning Findings

```
[W-01] `auditor.md` omitted from enumeration of auditor files with developer-local MCP deps
Category: Documentation
Severity: Warning
File: docs/features/opencode-runtime.md
Lines: 197 (the changed paragraph)
Description: The updated sentence lists "the independent auditor sub-agents `auditor-kimi.md`,
`auditor-qwen.md`, and `auditor-glm.md`" as requiring Tavily and Context7. However,
`auditor.md` (the parent/primary auditor) also has both `"io.github.upstash/context7/*": true`
and `"io.github.tavily-ai/tavily-mcp/*": true` in its tools: frontmatter (lines 33–34 of
`.opencode/agents/auditor.md`, verified). `synthesizing-auditor.md` correctly has no such
dependency and is correctly omitted. The researcher-family sentence lists all five researcher
files including the parent `researcher.md`; parallel structure and accuracy both require
listing `auditor.md` alongside the three sub-agents.
A developer reading this section to configure their local Opencode environment would
reasonably conclude only the three model-specific sub-agents need Tavily/Context7, leaving
the parent `auditor.md` non-functional without a clear error.
Suggestion: Change the auditor enumeration to:
  "`auditor.md`, `auditor-kimi.md`, `auditor-qwen.md`, and `auditor-glm.md`"
  (dropping the "independent" qualifier, which was the implicit source of the omission)
```

```
[W-02] `AGENTS.md` companion file not updated — still names only the researcher family
Category: Documentation
Severity: Warning
File: AGENTS.md
Lines: 30
Description: `AGENTS.md` line 30 reads: "The researcher family depends on developer-local
Tavily and Context7 MCP servers configured in `~/.config/opencode/opencode.json`; the
checked-in `opencode.json` keeps only project-level runtime settings plus Chroma."
This sentence was not updated in the PR and now contradicts the corrected statement in
`docs/features/opencode-runtime.md`. A developer onboarding from `AGENTS.md` (the canonical
entry point documented in `opencode.json` `instructions:`) receives the stale/incomplete
picture. The companion-file sweep defined in Phase 1 of the shared review process applies here.
Suggestion: Update AGENTS.md line 30 to: "The researcher and auditor families depend on
developer-local Tavily and Context7 MCP servers configured in
`~/.config/opencode/opencode.json`; the checked-in `opencode.json` keeps only project-level
runtime settings plus Chroma."
```

---

## Overall Assessment

The change is directionally correct and the core claim (auditor family carries developer-local MCP deps) is accurate. It is not ready to merge as-is: W-01 leaves `auditor.md` silently undocumented as a Tavily/Context7 consumer, and W-02 leaves `AGENTS.md` — the file explicitly loaded by `opencode.json` as the primary instructions source — stating the opposite of the corrected doc. Both are one-line prose fixes with zero code risk.
